risks.title: Acquisition integration risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to significant risks related to the integration of acquired businesses. The filing explicitly mentions potential integration difficulties, associated costs and limitations of indemnification rights. These risks could have a negative impact on operating results

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in areas subject to strict regulations regarding environment, safety and others. Non-compliance can result in severe penalties and material impact on operations

risks.title: Accounting estimates and judgment risks
risks.score_rationale: Revenue recognition on long-term contracts and estimates of future costs require significant judgments. Estimation errors could materially affect financial results

risks.title: Retirement and actuarial assumption risks
risks.score_rationale: Retirement plans carry significant risks related to actuarial assumptions: discount rates, anticipated returns. Even modest changes (1%) could impact liabilities by $139 million

risks.title: Litigation and insurance risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces litigation risks: professional liability, bodily injury claims, and self-insures a portion of losses. Insurers may not honor all claims

risks.title: Redeemable non-controlling interests risks
risks.score_rationale: The PA Consulting investment creates a complex fair value measurement obligation based on projected future revenues and EBITDA. Holders have repurchase options based on fair value, creating potential volatility

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not mentioned AI, machine learning or similar technologies in the excerpts provided. Its positioning on this topic is therefore not analyzable from this information
